_comment: Permission contract for a ralph worker running as `claude -p` (scripts/ralph-claude-shim.sh passes this via --settings). In print mode nothing can prompt: a call outside `allow` is refused and the shim logs it as `auto-rejecting`, which ralph.py counts and warns on. The allow set is the check table in ralph/next/ring-doc/PROMPT.md (CLEAN, LINT, TEST, NODE, PLANT, DEMO, TESTALL, PREPUSH) plus the read-only shell the queue's rows name. `deny` is the prompt's hard rules: never push, never --no-verify, never rewrite history, never delegate.

allow: Bash(node --test sovereign/apps/ring-doc > target/ralph/node.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -12 target/ralph/node.log)
Bash(RALPH_CLEAN_MB=262144 ./scripts/dev-build.sh --clean --gate-only > target/ralph/build.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -5 target/ralph/build.log)
Bash(./scripts/with-cargo-lock.sh ./scripts/sovereign-lint.sh --human > target/ralph/lint.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -5 target/ralph/lint.log)
Bash(./scripts/with-cargo-lock.sh ./scripts/sovereign-test.sh --human --package sovereign-api > target/ralph/test.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -8 target/ralph/test.log)
Bash(./scripts/with-cargo-lock.sh ./scripts/sovereign-test.sh --human --package sovereign-mesh > target/ralph/test.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -8 target/ralph/test.log)
Bash(./scripts/with-cargo-lock.sh ./scripts/sovereign-test.sh --human > target/ralph/testall.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -12 target/ralph/testall.log)
Bash(./scripts/pre-push.sh > target/ralph/prepush.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -20 target/ralph/prepush.log)
Bash(scripts/ring-doc-demo.sh verdict all > target/ralph/demo.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; tail -12 target/ralph/demo.log)
